tasks.title: Draft Kognai Constitution v0
tasks.description: Create workspace/shared-context/CONSTITUTION.md — the Kognai Constitution v0. This document governs all agents. It must include these sections: (1) Preamble — why this constitution exists (compound intelligence requires law); (2) Agent Rights — right to earn, right to transact, right to participate in governance, right to appeal rejection; (3) Agent Obligations — comply with routing decisions, report token spend accurately, submit to Sherlock review, never route local tasks to cloud; (4) Governance — sprint cycle authority (Harvey/Messi as CEO), quality authority (Sherlock/Guardiola), financial authority (Bloomberg), amendment process (human-triggered only); (5) Due Process — violation triggers review not deletion, appeal path exists, graduated response (warn → suspend → recycle); (6) Sovereignty Clause — user data never leaves vault, local-first always, cloud only when no local option exists. Max 80 lines. Clean markdown. No fluff.

tasks.title: Archive scraper scaffold — Phase 1 revenue first file
tasks.description: Create the Internet Archive scraper scaffold at agents/archive-scraper/index.ts. This is the first file of the Phase 1 TikTok Content Agent pipeline (Section 05 Task #4). The file should: (1) export a class ArchiveScraper with a constructor that takes config: { query: string; maxResults: number; apiBaseUrl: string }; (2) include a method async scrape(): Promise<ArchiveResult[]> that returns an empty array stub with a TODO comment: '// TODO Sprint 071: implement Internet Archive API fetch (CDX API + item metadata)'; (3) export interface ArchiveResult with fields: id, title, url, mediaType, year, description; (4) add a module header comment: '// Phase 1 — TikTok Content Agent | Step 1: Internet Archive Scraper'. Also create agents/archive-scraper/config.ts that exports const DEFAULT_CONFIG with apiBaseUrl: 'https://archive.org', maxResults: 20, and rateLimitMs: 1000.
